written_by: development agent from the five catalog photos, before any miu run; evaluator-only input
identity_features: Rimless: two oval clear lenses with no rim at all; the lens edge is a bare polished edge
Thin gold metal bridge: a slim rounded bar between the lenses, slightly arched, mounted to each lens by a small gold block
Ornate 'miu miu' lettering blocks: at each lens mount (bridge side and temple side) and at the temple hinge, a small gold openwork block shaped like the letters miu miu, with visible screw heads
Nose pads: clear/pale pads on short gold pad arms attached at the bridge mounts
Temples: thin round gold wire rods running straight back from the hinge block, ending in tortoise (amber/brown mottled) acetate tips that bend down
Hinge region: the temple starts with a flat gold plate/lettering block at the lens mount, then the round wire
Materials: polished gold-tone metal (mirror-like, warm yellow), clear lenses (slight edge reflections), translucent tortoise acetate tips
Proportions: total width about 3.7 times the lens height; oval lenses wider than tall (roughly 50 x 34 at the nominal 140 mm width); a wide bridge gap (about 22 mm)
conditions_for_success: no rim geometry: lenses are free-standing with mounts only at the bridge and temple sides
gold hardware present at both mounts and hinges with a recognisable openwork silhouette; nose pads on arms
wire temples with tortoise tips and downward bend, continuous to the clip depth
clear lens optics (high transmission) in the AR renderer; two optical meshes detected
front silhouette (hardware + lenses) within the provisional thresholds
